# pkguard

> Audit package-manager security settings and advisories across monorepos and folders of projects.

## Install

```
bun install -g pkguard
```

Requires Bun on PATH. Standalone binaries are on GitHub Releases.

## Commands

See https://pkguard.dev/docs/commands for flags generated from the CLI catalog.

## Links

- Site: https://pkguard.dev
- Docs: https://pkguard.dev/docs
- GitHub: https://github.com/jackmcpickle/pkguard
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/pkguard
